option_evidence.lace_and_piece_interpretation: Page description explicitly makes lace curtains conditional on choosing the lace-curtain-included option. At width 100cm it describes two main curtains and, if included, two lace curtains; at width 150cm it describes one main curtain and, if included, one lace curtain. The title calls the product a lace-curtain set, but returned SKU selector placeholders did not expose the actual lace selection labels.

matching_evidence_summary: Both observed titles name curtains and lace-curtain sets; both product descriptions specify the same width-dependent curtain/lace piece composition. The observed Wowma SKU matrix exposes color and size labels; Rakuten page response exposes colors and sizes in product description, while its SKU selection placeholders are empty. This supports product-level correspondence and color/size comparison, but the captured Rakuten response does not expose a concrete SKU option matrix or lace-inclusion choice labels.
